name: THSV StreamBridge - Streamer Punishments
author: surakage
description: Two broker-authorized, triggerless actions: Set Filter turns one OBS source filter on or off for a screen effect, and Switch Scene moves OBS to the safe scene for an exercise and back.

actions.name: THSV Extension - Streamer Punishments - Set Filter
THSV Extension - Streamer Punishments - Switch Scene

triggerSafety: Set Filter and Switch Scene must remain triggerless. StreamBridge supplies a one-use broker token, an exact OBS source and filter name or scene name, and a bounded connection index, and owns all timing.
verificationStatus: Uses Streamer.bot's documented ObsIsConnected, ObsSetScene and ObsSendRaw methods and the OBS WebSocket 5 SetSourceFilterEnabled request; live OBS changes remain creator acceptance-tested.
